meaning: 非常非常尴尬、羞得想找地缝钻
usageNote: 口语强调用！叠加两个really就是在疯狂加戏，比super embarrassed还传神，脸红到耳根那种！

examples.en: I called my teacher 'mom' by accident — I was really really embarrassed.
examples.zh: 我不小心叫老师'妈妈'——我真的真的超级尴尬。

examples.en: She tripped in front of everyone and felt really really embarrassed.
examples.zh: 她在所有人面前绊倒了，尴尬得要命。
